limiters: none: no clamp, min/max, state-dependent table index or branch, so no frozen-coefficient treatment is applied
tables: mpas_static_ngn[140] (copied into the entry as cmb_ngc/cmb_ngn, checked equal to the forward source)
precondition: raw, rwgt and out are distinct allocations or disjoint views (true in every capture: 3 allocations, offset 0). out is fully overwritten (points*ngc[band] words); in the AD thread g is the only writer of its raw, rwgt and out words.
precision: aug: the forward word for word in f32 (__f*_rn), built --fmad=false --ftz=false, bitwise to the forward image. tl/ad: local partials and sums in double, one rounding to f32 per written word (the glue-row rule).
binder_roles: deriv.rs roles(): raw/rwgt TL in, AD accumulate (spec role in, never snapshotted); out TL out, AD inout (seed read and consumed in place).
